data: Stony (S-type) near-Earth asteroid, 34 × 11 × 11 km, the first near-Earth asteroid ever found (1898). NASA's NEAR Shoemaker went into orbit around it on 14 February 2000 — the first spacecraft to orbit an asteroid — mapped it for a year, then landed on it on 12 February 2001, though it was never designed to.
NEAR Shoemaker — NASA, 2000 orbit insertion (first asteroid orbiter); 2001 landing
Eros is a near-Earth Amor asteroid — semi-major axis 1.46 AU, its whole orbit outside Earth's. In 2000 NEAR Shoemaker matched that orbit and became the first spacecraft to orbit an asteroid.
Half the longest diameter of the orbit ellipse — and the single number that sets the orbital period.
